mentions.name: Semi-local DMARC tool
mentions.description: A DMARC tool designed to run semi-locally for a set of low-volume email domains, built as a simpler alternative to existing DMARC tools. It is still in the reading specs and tinkering stage.
mentions.problem: The author was unhappy with all the existing DMARC tools and wants something simple to run semi-locally for a bunch of low-volume email domains.
mentions.source_excerpt: Also dicking around with DMARC tools. Was unhappy with all the existing tools, want something simple I can run semi-locally for a bunch of low volume email domains. Haven't decided yet how that will turn out, still in the reading specs & tinkering stage.
